lines.t: A rainy dawn, the streets were gray
I ducked inside to drift away
The sign above, red shepherds brew
And peace just wrapped me through
Through and through, the air was rich
A holy sin, soft warmth arose
Where chill would spin
A kind-eyed man, behind the bar
Said welcome, you've come so far
I glanced above at the shining board
Names of drinks that praise the Lord
Faith rose bold, mercy maquillado
Spirit steaming, grace gelado
Redeemer's roast, the promised blend
Eternal light, it had no end
He asked me softly, what'll it be?
I said, your choice surprised me
Taste and see that the Lord is good
Stirs my heart the way love would
Living water fills my soul
In this cup I'm made whole
He said, whoever drinks of me
Will never thirst again
And I felt my heart begin to mend
He poured my cup and shimmered bright like sunrise
Breaking through the night
He spoke of peace beyond the rain
Of love that heals the deepest pain
My brew is joy
He said, now, Lord, it's grace that flows forevermore
Each sip revealed a spark divine
I knew the strength was more than mine
Taste and see that the Lord is good
Stirs my heart the way love would
Living water fills my soul
In this cup I'm made whole
He said, whoever drinks of me will never thirst again
And I saw heaven shine within
Then light poured through his quiet grin
And I knew his face, my sin grew thin
Sir, I guess my eyes opened wide
You're your shoe right here inside. He smiled and said my child is true
I've been waiting here for you
My spirit free for yahushua poured for me
Now every morning
When I wake, I sip his peace for his sake Faith rose, warms my heart anew
I met my savior in shepherd's brook And the sign still whispers, like morning dew
Taste and see, that the Lord is good, it's true
Thank you.
Thank you.
